learningCurve.reason: durable observation, procedural, route-choice, trace, and model-runtime observation records now append to Store logs and can be replayed into projections; full longitudinal graph-dependent curve rollup remains follow-up

dogfoodLessons.lesson: The local runtime contract is backend-neutral, but the first-class path is llama-cpp/GGUF, not ONNX-first.
Contract proof and execution proof are different things; a degraded/default build is honest, but it is not parity.
Token reduction can be real even when reranker lift is still zero, so those metrics must be tracked separately.
Model observations stay append-only first, then project into graph/memory views; the proof must distinguish persisted observation facts from derived graph curves.
A broad QA runner can create fake red by claiming rows it cannot prove; runner claim logic must be fixture-backed and leave unsupported rows unrunnable.
Runtime model proof must be CPU-first and one-model-at-a-time by default; GPU/NPU requires provider probes and child-process timeout protection.
Rollup proof must be derived from artifact evidence; stale pending rows can hide completed model, token, Store, RAG, dogfood, and parity work just as badly as fake green can overclaim it.

blockers: Full graph-dependent recurrence curves still need the derived projection rollup over Store logs.
Checked-in real model runtime proofs remain host-local and non-CI-parity; rerun explicit probes when hardware, cache, or providers change.
QA coverage is 40/250 runnable with 0 failures; unsupported rows remain unrunnable rather than fake green.
